text.en:
Laguna Lake Rehabilitation Project - Project
Management Office. There is hereby created a Laguna Lake Rehabilitation
Project - Project Management Office (LLRP-PMO) to implement the Laguna Lake
Rehabilitation Project.

Administrative Supervision.
The Department of
Environment and Natural Resources (DENR), through the River Basin Control
Office (RBCO), shall have the direct administrative supervision over the LLRP-

Organizational Structure. The organizational structure
of the LLRP-PMO shall be composed of three (3) units:
a. Operations Division
b. Monitoring Division
c. Financial and Administrative Services Division

Staffing. The LLRP-PMO shall be staffed with the
a. Project Management Officer
b. Deputy Project Management Officer
c. Technical Personnel
d. Support/Non-Technical Personnel

Scope of Authority and Responsibility. The LLRP-PMO
shall have the following responsibilities:
a. Ensure effective implementation and management of the Laguna Lake
Rehabilitation Project;
b. Coordinate, supervise and monitor project activities implemented by
the contractor;
c. Provide technical assistance to the contractor on the following areas:
1. Dredging of Laguna Lake Nautical Highway and Napindan
2. Shoreland reclamation and development;
3. Construction of Ferry Stations and Terminals;
4. Construction of Wastewater treatment plants;
5. Other project components or areas deemed requiring technical
assistance from the LLRP-PMO;
d. Validate the contractor's accomplishments and prepare validation
e. Mange and coordinate the implementation of the Project to all
concerned national government agencies, private sector and other

entities that have stakes in the development and rehabilitation of the
f. Manage the efficient utilization of its Maintenance and Other Operating
Expenses (MOOE);
g. Facilitate the coordination and implementation of activities between
the different agencies involved in management and development of
the Laguna de Bay area;
h. Coordinate and plan with the relevant line agencies and local
government units to ensure proper operation and maintenance of the
infrastructures to be constructed in the area as per approved feasibility
=.
Prepare and submit weekly and monthly progress report to the
Assistant Secretary of the RBCO;
j. Conduct information, education, communication and advocacy
campaign relating to the benefits and advantages of the project to
support socio-economic development, ecological restoration and
environmental stability of the Laguna Lake Region;
k. Administer its finance and procurement; and
1. Undertake other duties and functions as may be necessary to perform
its mandate.

Implementation Arrangement. The LLRP-PMO under
the DENR-BCO shall be supported by the Laguna Lake Development Authority
(LLDA), an agency under the DENR. All other departments, government
agencies and entities concerned are hereby ordered to provide full cooperation
for the timely and smooth execution of the program.

Budgetary Support. The amount of Twenty Five Million
Pesos (P 25,000,000.00) to be sourced from unprogrammed funds of the DENR,
and/or as may be recommended and/or approved by the Department of Budget
and Management (DBM), shall be released every year to support the operations
and administration of the LLRP-PMO under the BC to carry out the
implementation of the project until its completion.

Inter-Agency Cooperation. The departments, bureaus,
offices, agencies or instrumentalities, including government-owned or controlled
corporations, are hereby directed to extend such assistance and cooperation as
the RBCO-LLRP-PMO may need in the discharge of its functions.

Repeal. All executive orders, rules and regulations and
other issuances or parts thereof, which are inconsistent with this Executive
Order, are hereby revoked, amended, or modified accordingly.
57650

Effectivity. This Executive Order shall take effect fifteen
(15) days after its complete publication in a national newspaper of general
circulation and fifteen (15) days after registration with the Office of the National
Administrative Register.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 7th day of June
of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Ten.
By the President:
Executive Secretary
